The event offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all abilities and ages.

Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards also given in the children’s categories and to the best runners from Štiavnička. The organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.

The route is flat with no elevation gain, making for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities, with €2 from every entry fee going towards motivating them to be physically active.

name: Polus Tower Run

Runners start individually at 30-second intervals, and times are recorded using an electronic system. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and conducted under current TWA rules.

The event offers categories for children, a main race, and Nordic walking, with the start in front of the amphitheater in the Castle Garden. The organizers emphasize safety and recommend reflective accessories and headlamps. Finisher medals are prepared for the first 550 participants.

Runners can earn ITRA Score points and compete against the best on an extreme course with 944 metres of elevation gain. The event offers a challenge for both professional and recreational runners in the beautiful surroundings of Martinky. It also includes children’s categories with shorter courses and parental accompaniment. The organizers provide transport for personal belongings to the finish, refreshments and free parking.

After the race, participants can enjoy game goulash, a raffle, medals and prizes for the winners. Runners take part at their own risk. Online registration is available, with a participant limit, and children run for free.

The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross-country running in the pleasant surroundings of Trstín.

The event supports a good cause: all funds raised will go towards treatment for a 4-year-old boy with autism and the “Children of My Heart” project. Participants will receive gifts, raffle tickets and commemorative medals, and there will be entertainment for children, so parents can run while their children are looked after. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish.

The entry fee includes one raffle ticket, with additional tickets available to purchase. Every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. Professional entertainers and attractions will be available for children. Parking is available by the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual runners will be sent a gift and medal to their address after the event. The terrain consists of dirt roads and asphalt. Changing rooms, showers and refreshments are available on site. Registration is available online, with a virtual participation option.

The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments along the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian.

The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.

The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer the lively atmosphere of a quality sporting event.

Runners can expect well-organized routes with clear markings, refreshment stations, and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.

The routes start at the iconic Rača Amphitheatre and follow the boundary between the Carpathian forest and vineyards, offering forest therapy, varied terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Runners can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross, which lets them run with their dog.

Competitions are divided into age categories for both men and women, with the top three in each category receiving awards.

Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest meter.

The event brings together civilian and military runners and promotes physical fitness and community spirit. The entry fee includes a race pack, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and chip timing.

Dogs must remain on a leash or in a harness throughout the route; allowing a dog to roam freely results in disqualification. The organizers recommend the MID route for experienced participants and SHORT for newcomers or those with less training.

The organizers prioritize safety, so headphones are prohibited and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes notable sites such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, and runners can also enjoy a varied programme of accompanying activities.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry

name: Strečnianska mašľa

The race offers two routes: a challenging 50 km course with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain and a shorter 25 km course, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of the national park. The start and finish are at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organisers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and quality facilities for participants.

name: Krosak pod hradom

name: Kysucký maratón

The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Runners compete in various age categories and have access to aid stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.

The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.

The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes in kind for the winners.

The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike who want to experience mountain nature and unforgettable views.

location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Atletická dráha
description: The Banská Štiavnica–Visegrád Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race connecting two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube–Ipoly National Park. The race is open to teams of 3, 4 to 8, and 6 runners, with categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route runs mainly along hiking trails and through nature reserves, offering a chance to discover the region’s cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty in Slovakia and Hungary. The organizers emphasize building good neighborly relations and promoting the region.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
location: Kuchajda, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Bratislava 2 Miles Run is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The event also includes a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with runners scored according to their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
location: Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov na začiatku obce pri rieke Orava
description: The Žaškov Mini Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the 55th year in the village of Žaškov in Orava. The course runs mostly along forest roads and village streets, covering approximately 12.4 km with around 600 m of elevation gain. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a pleasant, family-friendly atmosphere. This mini marathon is part of the Šípsko–Fatranské Runs series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Kolonica, okr. Snina, Kolonica, okr. Snina, športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč
description: The Cyril and Methodius Run over Kolonický vrch – Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica, Snina District. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The children’s races start at 13:30 and the adults’ race at 15:00. The event is held in memory of Jozef Chomanič and gives runners of all ages the chance to compete in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, rekreačná oblasť Domaša, Eva, pizzeria Palermo
description: Domašská Desiatka na Eve is a traditional running race held in the Domaša recreational area, Eva, near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations, and after finishing they receive a race pack with a medal, food, and a drink. The organizers provide medical services. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
location: Nízke Tatry, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a 98 km main loop from Telgárt to Donovaly, crossing the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance route finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organized by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced mountain runners.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
location: Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, in Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The race offers categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice
description: The KL Auto Run through the Rajec Valley is a running event set in the scenic Rajec Valley, offering a combination of paved and country roads. The course runs mostly along country roads, with approximately 20% paved surface, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.

The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the best-decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with registration and the start on the square.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón

organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba in the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—which follow an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organizers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička, and Športový klub Štrba.

name: Kordícky Extrém
location: Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Obecný úrad
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.

The course is designed for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage on this extreme terrain.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Mestisko, okres Svidník, Mestisko, okres Svidník, futbalové ihrisko
description: Mesciské Pancakes is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km routes for men and women with no age restrictions. The route runs mostly on asphalt, with sections across grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football field in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
location: Hrabovo, Hrabovo, Hrabovo
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletracks, and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and the length of the course. Three courses of varying distances and elevation gains are available, catering to runners of different levels.

name: Bančanská desiatka
location: Banské, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Prievidza, Prievidza, Námestie J. C. Hronského
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza featuring 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and relay events are also available for children. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times for each distance. The organizers are YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.

name: Ipelský Beh

description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec–Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mostly over grass and includes a 100-metre section of disused railway track. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and youth, and also includes Nordic walking. The organizers are the town of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, who warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
location: Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, RO Domaša - Dobrá

The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, including children. It is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in different age groups. Registration is available online or on site until the participant limit is reached.

name: Night city run Piešťany
location: Piešťany, Piešťany, Námestie Slobody
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night race held at Námestie Slobody in Piešťany. Runners can take part in the 10 km race, which runs through the city and offers the unique atmosphere of a night run under the auspices of the City of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. Electronic timing is provided during the race, and the award ceremony takes place in the evening after the run.

It is intended for endurance runners seeking a more extreme experience over the marathon distance. The organizers provide quality conditions and support for all participants.

description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long, with an elevation gain of 680 metres, and follows mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the 2025 Turiec Running League and is open to various age categories for men and women. It is organised by BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
location: Poľana, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race set in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with over 1,300 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and 10 km with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through popular hiking spots such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Kaľamárka Celtic hillfort, and the summit of Predná Poľana. Runners can enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.

name: Porubska 11-ka
location: Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, which offers a combination of flat stretches and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run in nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
location: Lednické Rovne, Medné, Lednické Rovne, Medné, Medné
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance, and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural surroundings. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills, with a variety of technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, from beginners to experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.

The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The competition is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a travelling cup based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.

The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organised by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.

description: Východniarska is a mountain ultratrail and long-distance hike for individuals, building on the popular Východniarska stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly through the Volovské vrchy, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public to participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the entry fee.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.

Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the course and use the rented timing chips, which must be returned at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finishing straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.

name: Rajecká štafeta
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajec Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course winds through beautiful countryside and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and scenic views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.

The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football pitch in the Prešov District and offers categories for different age groups of men, women, and youth. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

The course is suitable for runners of various levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners looking to enjoy a sporting event in a beautiful setting.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Demänovská dolina
description: The Relay Run from the Tatras to the Danube is the largest relay race in Slovakia, covering a distance of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is mostly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of total ascent and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 legs of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each member runs three legs. The race is a test of team spirit and endurance in Slovakia’s beautiful surroundings.

name: Jazerný maratón
location: Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, splav Jazero 0-tý km /Jenisejská ul./Košice
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of varying levels. The event has a 15-year tradition and is ideal for those looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, priestor pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku
description: The Count Július Andrássy Route Run takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers several categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for August 21, 2026, at 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all ages, including children up to 7 and older children up to 13. The organizer, Ing. Michal Majcher, ensures a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality race organization.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
location: Stropkov, Stropkov, Námestie SNP
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance walk starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes lead through the Ondava Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing a region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is certified by ITRA, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organized by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides a warm welcome and high-quality organization.

The race offers various categories, including a 5 km hobby race for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course runs along paved roads, meadows, and forest and field paths, offering a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 11:00.

name: Čachtický polmaratón
location: Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, námestie

The course is mostly on asphalt, running through the streets of Čachtice to Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The route is gently rolling, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is on the grounds of the Čachtice Elementary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci

Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.

The event offers a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men, women, and a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race begins at 11:00.

name: Harhovská desiatka

description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The races are divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.

name: Brezovský letný beh

description: The Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District. Its route runs along asphalt, field, and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including participants aged 15 and under and those over 15.
